none: PAS FindID 983592: Lin-6826BB: Roman hummus of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of the House of Constantine (AD 306-337), dating to the period AD 330-331 (Reece Period 17). Wolf and twins reverse type. Obverse VRBS ROMA. Mint of Trier. Probably as RIC VII, p.215, no.529. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Roma left wearing imperial cloak. Obverse inscription: VRBS-ROMA. Reverse description: She-Wolf suckling Twins. Mintmark: //TRP. Diameter: 18.01 mm; Thickness: 1.51 mm; Weight: 1.94g
